# megooflags_project (Data Source)

Reads a project and its environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "megooflags_project" "shop" {
  key = "shop"
}

output "environments" {
  value = [for e in data.megooflags_project.shop.environments : e.key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Project key.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `stale_after_days` (Number) Days without evaluations after which a flag is stale.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `approvals_required` (Number) Approvals a change request needs here.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `key` (String) Environment key.
- `name` (String) Display name.
